conditions.leftValue: ={{ (function(){ try { const u=($json.url||'').trim(); const sc=/^(https?:\/\/)/i.test(u); if(!sc) return false; const m=u.match(/^(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?([^\/]+)/i); const h=m?m[1].toLowerCase():''; return ['rts-tender.ru','b2b-center.ru','tenderland.ru','tender.pro','zakupki.gov.ru','vsem-podryad.ru'].some(function(d){ return h===d || h.endsWith('.'+d); }); } catch(e){ return false; } })() }}
